title: Release Engineering Meeting Notes - 2026-11-10
content:
Attendees: Samir Patel (lead), Lina Zhou, Marcus Green, Priya Desai, Tomás Alvarez, Jo Park (notes), David Kim (SRE join), Claire Hsu (product - partial)

Agenda:
- Quick sync on current release train and readiness for 2026-11-17 weekly deploy
- Review outstanding hotfixes and the postmortem for 2026-11-08 production degradation
- Changelog items and release notes for next week
- Rollout plan (canary thresholds, fallback policy)
- Action items and owners

1) Release train status (2026-11-17)
- Cut window: Tue 2026-11-16 18:00 UTC (branch-cut and artifact freeze). Target deploy: Wed 2026-11-17 02:00 UTC (global rollout).
- Release lead: Samir. Release manager: Lina. QA lead: Marcus. SRE on-call: David.
- Current PRs targeting the train: ~22 PRs open. 16 are reviewed/approved, 6 in review or blocked by infra changes. Key PRs:
  - PR#518 (release-manager): finalizes staged rollout hooks - awaiting e2e signoff (Marcus).
  - PR#527 (runtime): improve kv-cache trimming to reduce memory spikes - in review (Priya).
  - PR#531 (console): route-level tracing toggle UI - approved, needs docs.

Blockers:
- Infra change RE-2045 (GPU driver update) needs to be present on staging before PR#527 can be fully validated. Release engineering to coordinate with infra team; Tomás to own.
- Canary test flakiness on 128-token scenarios observed in perf harness (intermittent). Marcus investigating; intermittent failures traced to batching behavior under a particular sequence-length distribution. Temporary mitigation: tighten canary traffic to 50rps and lower concurrency for staged pool.

Decision: Proceed with train but hold PR#527 as opt-in until infra driver is validated on staging. If infra validation completes by 2026-11-14 EOD, include; otherwise ship without and schedule a patch release.

2) Hotfixes / recent incident review (2026-11-08 production degradation)
- Incident summary: 2026-11-08 09:42-11:08 UTC, degraded tail latency on hosted API affecting ~3% of requests. Root cause: regression in automatic batching (commit 9a3f2b) that caused oversized batches to be formed under a rare request size distribution leading to head-of-line lock contention on the serving runtime.
- Mitigation applied: rollback commit 9a3f2b at 10:05 UTC and applied temporary batching throttle. Full restore at 11:08 UTC.
- Postmortem status: Draft posted to CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-2026-11 (link above). Actionable items already captured as JIRA tickets: JIRA-HOTFIX-4478 (immediate rollback + throttle), JIRA-ISSUE-4482 (add unit tests for batching edge cases), JIRA-OBS-4490 (increase perf harness coverage for mixed-length workloads).
- Customer impact: Some API users saw increased latency; no data loss. Support triage: CS ticket queue processed; outreach to top 10 customers completed.

Action items from incident:
- (Marcus) Finish reproducer and add unit/integration tests for the batching algorithm by 2026-11-12. JIRA-ISSUE-4482.
- (David) Increase perf harness scenarios to include mixed-length distributions and run nightly; update dashboard alerts for batch-size anomaly by 2026-11-13. JIRA-OBS-4490.
- (Priya + Tomás) Coordinate a staged deploy plan that includes a safety throttle for new batching changes; target 2026-11-19 (post-release) if PR#527 not included.

3) Changelog highlights (to be included in release notes)
- Improvements: KV-cache trimming optimization (PR#527) - optional if infra validated.
- Features: Route-level tracing toggle (PR#531) - UI change for operators.
- Bugfixes: Fix for duplicate webhook deliveries under retry (PR#512) - included.
- Observability: New perf harness scenario coverage and batch-size anomaly alerting (JIRA-OBS-4490).

Docs / Release Notes owners:
- Primary writer: Lina (prepare initial draft by 2026-11-15).
- Tech review: Priya & Marcus (by 2026-11-16).
- Product blurb: Claire (short customer-facing notes) by 2026-11-16.

4) Rollout plan and SLO safeguards
- Canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with 20-minute observation windows. Canary SLO thresholds: p95 latency increase < 8% over baseline and error rate < 0.1%.
- Automated rollback: if thresholds breached for two consecutive windows, rollback to previous artifact and open incident.
- Fallback model variants: route to lower-capacity but stable model v1.2 if runtime memory pressure exceeds threshold (SRE configured).
- Runbook check: Marcus to update the rollout runbook with steps for manual rollback and partial route disable by 2026-11-13.

5) Dependencies / cross-team notes
- Infra: RE-2045 GPU driver update (Tomás owning). Need confirmation that staging image with new driver is available by 2026-11-13.
- QA: Test account access for canary toggles - QA to provide smoke test checklist by 2026-11-14.
- Customer success: Pre-release outreach planned for top-tier customers on 2026-11-15 (Claire).

6) Action items (summary with owners and due dates)
- Tomás: Coordinate infra validation for RE-2045 on staging; due 2026-11-13.
- Marcus: Perf reproducer + tests for batching edge cases; due 2026-11-12. Update rollout runbook; due 2026-11-13.
- Lina: Initial release notes draft; due 2026-11-15.
- Samir: Final go/no-go check on 2026-11-16 16:00 UTC.
- David: Nightly perf harness updates and alerting; due 2026-11-13.
- Priya: Coordinate safety throttle and plan for post-release patch (if needed); due 2026-11-19.

Risks:
- If infra validation slips, we will omit PR#527 and plan a small patch release. This increases patch cadence and risk of more frequent deploys.
- Canary flakiness causes slower ramp and delayed customer-facing release. Extra QA cycles may be required.

Notes / Open questions:
- Claire: do we want a preemptive customer advisory acknowledging that some ops improvements are rolling out next week? (action: Claire to propose language by 2026-11-14).
- Legal/compliance: any export controls on the new runtime telemetry? (Samir to check)

Next meeting:
- Weekly sync: 2026-11-17 09:00 UTC (post-deploy wrap-up).
- Pre-cut dry run: 2026-11-16 15:00 UTC (needed if infra validation completes late).

Appendix: quick timeline references:
- 2026-11-12: tests and reproducer due (Marcus).
- 2026-11-13: infra staging confirmation + prod alert updates (Tomás, David).
- 2026-11-15: release notes draft and customer outreach copy (Lina, Claire).
- 2026-11-16 16:00 UTC: final go/no-go check.
- 2026-11-17 02:00 UTC: target rollout start.

End of notes.
